body:
Part of #237. Owner product acceptance and closure remain open on that issue.

Delayed saves and publish replies now reconcile against the accepted draft and the exact immutable version stored. A publish attempt preserves newer device edits, rechecks held input and conflicts before dispatch, and reads the server before retrying an uncertain request. If that read reveals a different server draft, the retry sends no POST and enters the existing Reload server draft / Overwrite with this copy recovery.

Messages distinguish the earlier uncertain request from the current click and describe what the named version contains, without incorrectly calling work unpublished in a newer release. Publication cancels other loops' in-flight validation before marking it stale for next use; it leaves the publishing loop's own checks alone.

## Current stack and verification

Draft head `35bb3fbdc724a82064d0d9e65b551608542c6b22`, tree `42bfce66017eb91f3fcd50ffdfb24876a47558f6`, includes PR #474's corrected parent `164c01a2e3a52bf0ef69a409e1a428b45817b1b8`. It is still targeted at that parent branch. Parent #474 has not merged; actual-main integration and retargeting remain required before final sign-off.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh corrected all four accepted findings from [formal scan 1 and root dispositions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/475#issuecomment-6882651485). The original change-required report remains retained; there are no deferred findings from that scan.

- On original source, 20 of the 52 final focused tests failed and 32 controls passed. Corrected source passed all 52 and 284 related tests, plus web no-emit types, lint and formatting. [Correction evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/35bb3fbdc724a82064d0d9e65b551608542c6b22/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-review-correction/README.md)
- The correction was frozen as `ea8eda37`, then merged without conflicts with parent `164c01a2` into source checkpoint `31340713`. All 122 combined focused tests across nine files, no-emit types and web lint passed. Six child correction source files, eleven parent correction source files and 374 inherited evidence blobs matched exactly in both index and commit. [Parent integration](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/35bb3fbdc724a82064d0d9e65b551608542c6b22/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-parent-correction-integration/README.md)
- The final publication adds only evidence and the delivery record. All 62 added evidence files (1,675,403 bytes) matched staged and committed Git blobs. The original 1,227 compiled files remain available for independent before-fix native checks.
- Independent native verification of the freshly built `35bb3fbd` stack passed all ten correction cases, four retained publication/pinned outcomes, three saved-draft/list/detail outcomes and both uncertainty controls on their first attempts, with no uncaught browser errors. All 37 source blobs, nine embedded sources and 1,227 built files matched before and after. All 14 fixture gateways and Edge sessions closed cleanly. The inherited-parent source-mapping rejection and cleanup-selector correction remain retained; neither changed product code or acceptance assertions.
- [Stacked-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43634737570) is still running; Windows, template image and [routing](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43634737582) have passed. Actual-main integration and final current-target checks remain required.
- One of three formal scans is consumed. Fresh whole-PR GPT-6 Astra max sign-off is planned as scan 2 after corrected QA, actual-main integration and current-target CI; scan 3 remains reserved.

## Historical baseline

The earlier `1dcee36b` stack passed all four CI jobs and routing on their first attempts: 22 coverage tasks, 2,551 web tests across 204 files, 479 browser passes plus one expected live-provider skip with no retries, Windows 14/14 and template image. Dependency audit passed its configured threshold with 8 low and 13 moderate advisories. [Baseline CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/35bb3fbdc724a82064d0d9e65b551608542c6b22/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-stacked-ci/README.md)

Earlier independent Edge/compiled-gateway/file-SQLite QA passed both uncertainty variants and 17 outcomes across publication, transport, list/detail, ancestry and refusal groups. It retained first fixture failures, verified immutable versions and pinned runs, and closed all 12 fixture instances. That evidence did not cover the four schedules found in scan 1 and does not accept their corrections. [Baseline native evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/35bb3fbdc724a82064d0d9e65b551608542c6b22/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-independent-corrected-native/README.md) · [Implementation history](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/35bb3fbdc724a82064d0d9e65b551608542c6b22/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-publication/README.md)

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the actual merged build and observations on #237. Confirm that saved/published and later-edit notices are understandable, refusal and recovery wording makes the available copies clear, and navigation/list updates feel trustworthy. Machine-checkable behavior remains the pipeline's responsibility. No provider run, owner instance/store change, data migration or owner acceptance is claimed.
